$comment: Lower-case substrings that mark an AI provider refusal as non-retryable for the rest of a run: a daily, billing or credit quota rather than a momentary rate limit. One list, read by the CLI (apps/cli/src/detectors/custom/runners/_llm.py) and the API (apps/api/src/ai/ai-client.service.ts), so a scan and an agent agree on what 'retrying cannot help' means. Measured origin: OpenRouter's free tier answers HTTP 429 'Rate limit exceeded: free-models-per-day. Add 10 credits to unlock 1000 free model requests per day', and retrying that for ~41s per asset held the only runner slot for 10 of 24 hours.
